newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates -Mid-Mississippi River still weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates -Mid-Mississippi River still weak.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained steady to weaker on the mid-Mississippi River Thursdayring the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Two barges, Lower Ohio River, next week, no bid, offer 110 percent.
- Two barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, next week, no bid, offer 105 percent.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, 120 percent of tariff, offered at 130 percent, down five percentage points from Wednesday.
- Eight barges, two each week October, mid-Mississippi bid 230 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Wednesday, similar, offered 240 percent, unchanged.
